scenes.text: This tutorial covers Replication assay. Score parasites per vacuole and summarize intracellular replication by condition.
Open Replication assay from the Toxoplasma assays section. Select host-cell, vacuole, and parasite measurements together with condition metadata.
In the main configuration area, configure spatial assignment, object filters, parasite-count bins, controls, and statistical comparisons.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect vacuoles across the full count range and verify that merged or fragmented masks are excluded.
When the workflow finishes, parasites-per-vacuole distributions, replication rates, statistics, and figures are saved.
